response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced (14+ years) full-stack engineer with deep exposure to TypeScript/Node.js, multiple languages (Java, C#, DLang), databases, Docker/Kubernetes, and CI/CD practices. Notably, his current role at re:cinq directly involves AI-agent infrastructure and MCP framework development, closely matching a key required skill. While explicit experience with React, Nest.js, and Vitest is not documented (he favors Ember.js and self-built tooling), his breadth, seniority, and adaptability across stacks suggest he could ramp up quickly.
strengths: Extensive 14+ year engineering career spanning full-stack, embedded, and infrastructure work
Current hands-on experience with AI-agent infrastructure and MCP frameworks, directly matching a required skill
Strong TDD/CI/CD discipline and polyglot programming background (TypeScript, Java, C#, DLang)
concerns: No explicit mention of React, Nest.js, or Vitest — core primary stack technologies
No clear evidence of Kotlin experience for secondary backend services
Security/auth best-practices and testing framework expertise not explicitly demonstrated in resume

key_factors.factor: Deep overall seniority and full-stack breadth
